newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Opposition plane drops bomb on Kabul - witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Opposition plane drops bomb on Kabul - witnesses.

text.p: A plane belonging to forces opposed to the Taleban Islamic militia dropped what appeared to be a single bomb on the northeast of the Afghan capital Kabul on Sunday, witnesses said.
There were no immediate reports of casualties from the raid, which took place at 12:15 p.m. (0745 gmt), the latest in a series of recent opposition air strikes on Kabul.
Taleban gunners responded with anti-aircraft fire.
Afghan watchers have said the recent opposition air raids were in retaliation for Taleban successes on the battle field north of Kabul. The Taleban took the capital in late September.
